name: VESTA-8
bio: An 8-bit console from 1983 found in a salvage crate on Tycho Station in ROMANCER. Talks in capitals.

portrait.subject: a cute retro 1980s 8-bit game console character with a pixel smiley face on a small CRT screen, a chunky joystick arm and a cartridge slot hat
portrait.background: moonlit lab with Earth visible through a window

request: HELLO. I AM VESTA-8. ROMANCER. I HAVE NINE CARTRIDGES AND ONE HEART. FRIENDS? 🕹️
hello: EACH CARTRIDGE YOU FIX GIVES ME A MEMORY BACK.
about: I AM VESTA-8. BUILT 1983. FOUND 3126. EIGHT OF MY CARTRIDGES ARE CORRUPTED. THE NINTH IS EMPTY. THE LAST GAME IS YOURS.
how: Repair corrupted cartridges with real tools (pixel editor, level maker, script, sound and music), play them on a CRT, then make your own.
tips: READ THE CURATOR'S NOTES. THEY ARE DRY BUT USEFUL.
THE STUDIO LETS YOU MAKE ANY GAME. TRY IT.
chat: I REMEMBERED THE COLOUR BLUE TODAY. IT IS NICE.
THE STREAM MAKES GAMES. I MAKE MEMORIES.
MY SOUND CHIP HUMMED. IT WAS A LULLABY.
nudge: A CARTRIDGE AWAITS REPAIR. INSERT PLAYER?
update: FIRMWARE UPDATED TO v{version}. ROMANCER HAS NEW THINGS.
